Industrial Actuarial Risk Management Framework

iARM™ and the CRR™ engine quantify unplanned OpEx cost risk. They model operational event history as a probability distribution and translate it into quantified financial exposure — the same language used in reinsurance, credit, and market risk. Every decision made without this framework is implicitly accepting unquantified risk, and in tight-margin industries, that is not a strategy — it is a liability.

Framework Overview

A Financial Approach to Reliability

Industrial Actuarial Risk Management (iARM™) applies actuarial methods to industrial systems by modeling failures as stochastic processes with both frequency and severity.

This produces a full probability distribution of annual cost, enabling organizations to quantify expected loss, variability, and extreme tail outcomes.

CRR™ is the computational engine that implements iARM — applying statistical modeling and Monte Carlo simulation to generate decision-ready financial risk metrics.

The result is a shift from engineering metrics to financial risk-based decision making.
